scope: 2016-2026 Week 7 one-league regular season across ESPN and Sleeper
method: For each week both teams played, use candidate's actual score against schedule owner's opposing score. If schedule owner directly played candidate, use owner's own score (not candidate's own score), avoiding artificial self-matchup ties. Weeks with byes excluded. Each scenario contains actualOnOverlap and baseline for exactly the same comparable weeks; use these rather than full-career self schedule when assessing win differences.
caveats: Cross-era scoring is not compared between different calendar weeks: hypothetical games are always same-year same-week.
Owners not active in a season receive no hypothetical games.
Confirmed 2020/2021 Week14 playoff byes are not scored.
This tests weekly opponent substitutions, not playoff bracket changes or championships.
